figures.name: chronology
figures.caption: Stage labels distinguish fitted decisions from history admission. Core downstream phases retain training-only state; online/later feedback policies are separately declared. Roster and release clocks remain availability proxies.

figures.name: online-probability-losses
figures.caption: Broad nonglobal online-rich comparisons on original matched targets: 55943 maps/1049 events and 25186 series/1047 events. Points are event-equal paired loss differences, negative favoring rich. Intervals use 131072 complete-event resamples, seed 20261016, conditional on saved fits; pointwise exploratory evidence without original-family corrected decisions. Both task rows share each loss scale; every declared reference appears.

figures.caption: Matched retained-weight feedback on the original 1,613 valid maps and 734 series across 23 events. Eighteen source-header regional events admit six-hour prior feedback; five unresolved events remain score-only. Pointwise 95% complete-event intervals use 131,072 draws, seed 20261021. Negative favors feedback. None of the 16 probability-loss contrasts passes conservative Holm. Loss scales match across horizons; all original scoring events are retained.

figures.name: online-calibration-slopes
figures.caption: Reporting-only canonical calibration slopes on 55,943 maps from 1,049 events and 25,186 series from 1,047 events. Pointwise 95% complete-event intervals use 2,048 draws, seed 20261024, with zero failed draws. The reference slope is one. Diagnostic fits never change forecasting probabilities. Complete tables retain intercept and 5/10/20-bin ECE intervals.

figures.name: exact-tie-contribution
figures.caption: Original deterministic decision accuracy and exact-tie-averaged accuracy on the same broad cohort. Each p=0.5 tie receives half credit in the latter; non-tied decisions and probability losses are unchanged. Counts and actual tied-subset Team A fractions accompany the complete table. These are descriptive decision diagnostics, not randomized accuracy measurements.
